universities.name: Ramakrishna Mission Vivekananda College (Autonomous), Chennai
universities.summary: Ramakrishna Mission Vivekananda College is an autonomous men’s college affiliated to the University of Madras in Mylapore, Chennai. It is a unit of Ramakrishna Mission Vidyapith. The aided Day College began in 1946 and the self-financing Evening College in 1974, with regular arts, science, commerce and postgraduate study within the Mission’s educational setting.

Day and Evening courses follow separate admission and fee arrangements; confirm practical attendance and the final departmental timetable.

Obtain the current departmental scheme, supervision arrangements and any compulsory materials or travel charges.

Ramakrishna Mission Vivekananda College is an autonomous men’s college affiliated to the University of Madras in Mylapore, Chennai. It is a unit of Ramakrishna Mission Vidyapith. The aided Day College began in 1946 and the self-financing Evening College in 1974, with regular arts, science, commerce and postgraduate study within the Mission’s educational setting.

The Mylapore campus combines academic departments, laboratories, library resources, smart classrooms, auditoriums and sports facilities. Students take part in subject associations, extension work, cultural activities and the institution’s value-based educational setting. Day and Evening courses follow separate admission and fee arrangements; confirm practical attendance and the final departmental timetable.

Current programme descriptions include subject laboratories, applied coursework, projects, fieldwork or specialist components according to the award. Evening computing study uses computer laboratories and technologies relevant to the curriculum. Social Work requires its particular field-based assessment. Obtain the current departmental scheme, supervision arrangements and any compulsory materials or travel charges.

The current Evening prospectus describes a canteen offering breakfast, lunch, tiffin and snacks. Ask about current menu, prices, hours and dietary or allergy requirements before budgeting. Food and accommodation are separate from academic tuition unless expressly included in the selected arrangement; no particular cuisine or full meal plan is assumed.

The current prospectus explicitly prohibits ragging and describes a written complaint route, alongside institutional conduct expectations. Obtain current emergency contacts and the process for raising concerns during admission or induction. Students should confirm health-care access, transport and accommodation arrangements separately, particularly for evening attendance and off-campus fieldwork.

Students can approach monastics and teachers for emotional support and guidance in the institution’s educational setting. The college provides library and digital-learning resources, departmental support and career-preparation activities. Confirm current access, office hours, disability assistance and applicable scholarship or category-document requirements rather than assuming automatic benefits.

The college is at P.S. Sivaswami Salai in Mylapore, Chennai. Plan local travel around the selected Day or Evening route and any fieldwork, laboratory or extension activity outside normal hours. Compare the current journey to campus before choosing accommodation, and confirm late-evening return arrangements for the self-financing session.

The college’s institutional profile records a boys’ hostel, but applicants should confirm current vacancies, eligibility, room type, charges and residence rules separately.
